# catalyst_appid (Data Source)

AppID data source

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "catalyst_appid" "example" {
  project_id = "my-project"
  name       = "my-app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) AppID name
- `project_id` (String) Project ID
